components.name: Keycap
components.summary: A keyboard hint. Inherits its colour, so it follows the text of whatever holds it.

props.name: held
props.doc: Drawn filled while the key is physically held, as ⌥ is during a peek.

components.name: Button
components.summary: A pill button. Every control in Lause shows its key, so pass `keycap` whenever there is one.

props.name: variant
props.doc: filled: the one primary action. outline: secondary. dim: tertiary, text only.

props.name: keycap
props.doc: The key that triggers this action; drawn as a Keycap after the label.

rules: Every control shows its key: pass keycap whenever there is one.
filled is the one primary action on a screen.

components.name: Progress
components.summary: The segmented bar under every screen: done in ink, current in accent, the rest faint.

props.name: total
props.doc: Number of units: sentences, cards, questions, arrows.

props.name: current
props.doc: Zero-based index of the current unit. Units before it are done. Pass `total` when everything is done.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name, e.g. "Lause 5 / 8".

rules: One segment per unit; the counts are given in words.

components.name: Bar
components.summary: Coverage of one domain: one segment per article. Read and retained in ink, read but not retained in accent, unread faint.

props.name: segments
props.doc: One entry per article, in article order.

props.name: label
props.doc: The counts in words, e.g. "Riigikord: 4 kinnistunud, 2 loetud, 4 lugemata, kokku 10". This is the accessible name.

rules: One segment per unit; the counts are given in words.

components.name: Dial
components.summary: A segmented control that behaves as a radio group: arrow keys move and select, Home/End jump.

props.name: options
props.doc: Two or three positions.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the group, e.g. "Tugi".

rules: The exam disables it as one control.

components.name: Tile
components.summary: An option or word tile. Tiles stack vertically in a TileStack; they never sit in a row except the two of a true/false item.

props.name: state
props.doc: idle: available. selected: chosen, accent ring. filled: written in, ink. dimmed: no longer relevant.

props.name: keycap
props.doc: The number key that picks this tile.

rules: Options stack vertically in a TileStack, never in a row, except the two of a true/false item.

components.name: TileStack
components.summary: The column that holds option tiles: 640px wide at most, one tile per row.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the group, e.g. "Vali õige vastus".

components.name: Bubble
components.summary:
A translation bubble that sits above the word it belongs to. Render it inside an element with
`position: relative`; it centres itself over that element and draws a tail down to it.

props.name: children
props.doc: The translation.

props.name: count
props.doc: How many times this term has been looked up; shown as ×N in accent.

props.name: note
props.doc: A short note after the count, e.g. the app's promotion text.

rules: Sits above its word; the count is decorative to assistive technology.

components.name: Sentence
components.summary: The reading unit: one sentence at reading size, its neighbours dimmed, its terms openable.

props.name: segments
props.doc: The sentence in reading order: plain strings and markable terms.

props.name: previous
props.doc: The neighbours, dimmed above and below.

props.name: support
props.doc: The dial level. et: no marks, terms still open. tugi: marks. korvuti: marks and the English under.

props.name: pinned
props.doc: Term ids whose bubble is shown.

props.name: counts
props.doc: Look-up tally per term id, shown in the bubble.

props.name: notes
props.doc: Per-term note shown after the count, e.g. the promotion text at three look-ups.

props.name: peeking
props.doc:
While true every gloss shows, pinned or not.
Announces nothing; the glosses are already in the accessibility tree and the app decides whether to announce the mode.

props.name: english
props.doc:
The Riigi Teataja English and the fixed unofficial-translation line, shown under the sentence
in korvuti; the note is never optional because the text is an unofficial translation of
constitutional law.

props.name: onToggle
props.doc: Called with the term id when a term is clicked or opened with Enter/Space.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the reading region, e.g. "Lause 5 / 8".

rules: The English pair (text + note) is required together: the note says the translation is unofficial.
Term ids that repeat pin together.

components.name: usePeek
components.summary:
The peek gesture: hold the modifier and every translation shows; release and it goes.
A latch holds the same state without the key. The held modifier clears when the window
loses focus or is hidden; the latch is the app's and survives blur. The modifier's keydown
is cancelled so it cannot move focus to the browser's menu bar.

props.name: latched
props.doc: The latch: holds the peek on without the key.

props.name: key
props.doc: The modifier that peeks while held.

props.name: enabled
props.doc: Set false to register no listeners and report `held: false`, e.g. while the reader is off-screen.

components.name: Nav
components.summary: The top chrome: context left, caps navigation centre, controls right.

props.name: context
props.doc: Top-left: where the learner is, e.g. "§ 60 · lause 5 / 8".

props.name: items
props.doc: The centre items. Empty in exam mode.

props.name: current
props.doc: The current item's id.

props.name: peeking
props.doc: While true the items read their English labels. The chrome swaps; it never gains a subtitle.

props.name: controls
props.doc: Top-right: the dial and the peek hint, or the exam's one action.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the navigation.

props.name: onNavigate
props.doc:
Supply this when the app owns routing. A plain left-click then calls it with the item id and
suppresses the browser's own navigation; modifier and middle clicks still open the link.
Leave it out and the links navigate by themselves.

rules: Chrome stays Estonian; while peeking it swaps to English and never gains a subtitle.

components.name: Cell
components.summary: One cell of the 2×2 drill: the subject, the verdict, and its key.

props.name: subject
props.doc: The row's subject, e.g. "Igaüks".

props.name: verdict
props.doc: The column's verdict, e.g. "tohib piirata".

props.name: keycap
props.doc: The number key that picks this cell.

rules: Rows Igaüks / Eesti kodanik, columns Tohib piirata / Ei tohi piirata; keys 1–4.

components.name: CellGrid
components.summary: The 2×2 drill laid out as a table, so the headers are read with each cell.

props.name: rows
props.doc: The two row headers, top to bottom.

props.name: columns
props.doc: The two column headers, left to right.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the table.

props.name: children
props.doc: Exactly four cells, in reading order: row 1 left, row 1 right, row 2 left, row 2 right.

rules: Use only token utilities: the Tailwind theme is closed, so bg-red-500 or p-11 do not exist.
Two fonts only: font-content (Young Serif) for what is being learned, font-chrome (Instrument Sans) for the app.
Type is used through the six roles (label, body, title, reading, headline, display), never a size number.
Contrast is a gate: every text pair 4.5:1, every graphic pair 3:1, in both modes.
Every interactive element has a visible focus ring; disabled never hovers.
